idea-plugin.name: Maven Dependency Analyzer
idea-plugin.description:
Fast analysis of Maven POMs in single- and multi-module projects.
  • Parses the whole module tree once and caches the result on disk.
  • Only re-parses changed POMs and re-validates the modules affected by them.
  • Validation: XML syntax, POM structure, multi-module consistency and property references.
  • Quick fixes for most problems, and suggestions to extract repeated versions into a property.
  • Find a dependency in all POMs and in the resolved transitive dependency trees (local repository).
  • Update a dependency version in every POM, excluding transitive copies with another version.
  • Explorer: browse modules with their resolved dependency trees, or every library with the modules that use it and its version conflicts; open any POM from there.
  • Paste a <dependency> snippet or coordinates to fill in the search fields.
  • Problems and quick fixes right in the pom.xml editor, and inlay hints with the effective version of managed and property versions, plus newer versions already in the local repository.
  • Graph: an interactive module graph in build order with dependency, parent and aggregation edges.
Open the Maven Analyzer tool window; use Full Refresh to discard the cache.
